  <script>
    const groups = document.querySelectorAll('.group-title');
    const expandAllBtn = document.getElementById('expand-all');
    const collapseAllBtn = document.getElementById('collapse-all');
    if (expandAllBtn) {
      expandAllBtn.addEventListener('click', expandAll);
    }
    if (collapseAllBtn) {
      collapseAllBtn.addEventListener('click', collapseAll);
    }

    groups.forEach((grp) => {
      grp.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const target = e.target;
        target.classList.toggle('active');
        target.classList.toggle('not-active');
        const group = target.nextElementSibling;
        group.classList.toggle('active');
        group.classList.toggle('not-active');

        // Update data-track-props attribute
        const currentProps = target.getAttribute('data-track-props') || '';
        const propsArray = currentProps.split(' ').filter(prop => prop !== 'active' && prop !== 'inactive');

        if (target.classList.contains('active')) {
          propsArray.push('active');
        } else {
          propsArray.push('inactive');
        }

        target.setAttribute('data-track-props', propsArray.join(' '));

      });
    });

    function makeGrpActive(grp) {
      grp.classList.add('active');
      grp.classList.remove('not-active');
      const group = grp.nextElementSibling;
      group.classList.add('active');
      group.classList.remove('not-active');
      if (expandAllBtn && collapseAllBtn) {
        expandAllBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        collapseAllBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        expandAllBtn.classList.remove('flex');
        collapseAllBtn.classList.add('flex');
      }
    }

    function makeGrpInactive(grp) {
      grp.classList.remove('active');
      grp.classList.add('not-active');
      const group = grp.nextElementSibling;
      group.classList.remove('active');
      group.classList.add('not-active');
      if (expandAllBtn && collapseAllBtn) {
        collapseAllBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        expandAllBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        collapseAllBtn.classList.remove('flex');
        expandAllBtn.classList.add('flex');
      }
    }

    function expandAll() {

          <h3 class="font-bold py-glg-base flex items-center justify-between pointer-events-none">How does the 14-day trial work?     <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xml:space="preserve" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" class="btn-close pointer-events-none transition-transform ease-in-out  ml-gut w-gut h-gut rotate-45"><title>Icon Close</title><path fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" d="M19 6.4 17.6 5 12 10.6 6.4 5 5 6.4l5.6 5.6L5 17.6 6.4 19l5.6-5.6 5.6 5.6 1.4-1.4-5.6-5.6L19 6.4z"></path></svg>
  </h3>
          <p class="faq-answer mb-glg-md hidden">Our trial is a full-featured free trial for 14 days that you can start using instantly. No credit card required so you won’t be charged until you are ready to buy. When you are ready, select any of the available plans to continue using PagerDuty.</p>
        </li>
                <li class="btn-toggle-faq border-b border-gray-light cursor-pointer">
          <h3 class="font-bold py-glg-base flex items-center justify-between pointer-events-none">What are my payment options?     <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xml:space="preserve" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" class="btn-close pointer-events-none transition-transform ease-in-out  ml-gut w-gut h-gut rotate-45"><title>Icon Close</title><path fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" d="M19 6.4 17.6 5 12 10.6 6.4 5 5 6.4l5.6 5.6L5 17.6 6.4 19l5.6-5.6 5.6 5.6 1.4-1.4-5.6-5.6L19 6.4z"></path></svg>
  </h3>
          <p class="faq-answer mb-glg-md hidden">We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, and JCB through your online account. Want to pay via invoice? Sure! We’ll gladly set up an annual invoice. Just call or contact us.</p>
        </li>
                <li class="btn-toggle-faq border-b border-gray-light cursor-pointer">
          <h3 class="font-bold py-glg-base flex items-center justify-between pointer-events-none">How many systems can I monitor?     <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xml:space="preserve" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" class="btn-close pointer-events-none transition-transform ease-in-out  ml-gut w-gut h-gut rotate-45"><title>Icon Close</title><path fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" d="M19 6.4 17.6 5 12 10.6 6.4 5 5 6.4l5.6 5.6L5 17.6 6.4 19l5.6-5.6 5.6 5.6 1.4-1.4-5.6-5.6L19 6.4z"></path></svg>
  </h3>
          <p class="faq-answer mb-glg-md hidden">You can monitor as many or as few systems as you want with PagerDuty. Whether you want to monitor one computer with Nagios or use Datadog, Icinga and Zenoss to monitor hundreds of applications across thousands of hosts, we won't charge you extra. We have 700+ pre-built integrations so you can connect PagerDuty to your monitoring tools of choice.</p>
        </li>
                <li class="btn-toggle-faq border-b border-gray-light cursor-pointer">
          <h3 class="font-bold py-glg-base flex items-center justify-between pointer-events-none">How many notifications are included in my account?     <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xml:space="preserve" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" class="btn-close pointer-events-none transition-transform ease-in-out  ml-gut w-gut h-gut rotate-45"><title>Icon Close</title><path fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" d="M19 6.4 17.6 5 12 10.6 6.4 5 5 6.4l5.6 5.6L5 17.6 6.4 19l5.6-5.6 5.6 5.6 1.4-1.4-5.6-5.6L19 6.4z"></path></svg>
  </h3>
          <p class="faq-answer mb-glg-md hidden">Notifications can be sent by email, push, SMS, and phone. All customers get unlimited email and push notifications. Professional, Business, and Digital Operations plans also get unlimited global SMS and phone notifications. Free customers receive 100 SMS and phone notifications.</p>
        </li>
                <li class="btn-toggle-faq border-b border-gray-light cursor-pointer">
          <h3 class="font-bold py-glg-base flex items-center justify-between pointer-events-none">Can I only purchase AIOps?     <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xml:space="preserve" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" class="btn-close pointer-events-none transition-transform ease-in-out  ml-gut w-gut h-gut rotate-45"><title>Icon Close</title><path fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" d="M19 6.4 17.6 5 12 10.6 6.4 5 5 6.4l5.6 5.6L5 17.6 6.4 19l5.6-5.6 5.6 5.6 1.4-1.4-5.6-5.6L19 6.4z"></path></svg>
  </h3>
          <p class="faq-answer mb-glg-md hidden">You will have to purchase at least one user on a Professional or Business Incident Response plan to be able to purchase AIOps.</p>
        </li>
                <li class="btn-toggle-faq border-b border-gray-light cursor-pointer">
          <h3 class="font-bold py-glg-base flex items-center justify-between pointer-events-none">Are there any lower cost options for users who are not responders?     <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xml:space="preserve" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" class="btn-close pointer-events-none transition-transform ease-in-out  ml-gut w-gut h-gut rotate-45"><title>Icon Close</title><path fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" d="M19 6.4 17.6 5 12 10.6 6.4 5 5 6.4l5.6 5.6L5 17.6 6.4 19l5.6-5.6 5.6 5.6 1.4-1.4-5.6-5.6L19 6.4z"></path></svg>
  </h3>
          <p class="faq-answer mb-glg-md hidden">You can purchase lower cost user licenses for business stakeholders who get read-only access to your PagerDuty products. If you purchase the Business plan or Digital Operations plan, stakeholder users can subscribe to incidents for real-time updates during critical outages to improve organization-wide response.</p>
        </li>
                <li class="btn-toggle-faq border-b border-gray-light cursor-pointer">
          <h3 class="font-bold py-glg-base flex items-center justify-between pointer-events-none">How is PagerDuty AIOps priced?     <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xml:space="preserve" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" class="btn-close pointer-events-none transition-transform ease-in-out  ml-gut w-gut h-gut rotate-45"><title>Icon Close</title><path fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" d="M19 6.4 17.6 5 12 10.6 6.4 5 5 6.4l5.6 5.6L5 17.6 6.4 19l5.6-5.6 5.6 5.6 1.4-1.4-5.6-5.6L19 6.4z"></path></svg>
  </h3>
          <p class="faq-answer mb-glg-md hidden">PagerDuty is committed to providing customers with the best value and ROI. With that in mind, PagerDuty AIOps is licensed per accepted event. Accepted events are any valid events that are sent to and processed by PagerDuty via email integration or API with a successful 2xx response. The number of events should correlate with the number of 2xx responses a customer receives back from the events API. For more details, <a class="text-green hover:underline" href="https://support.pagerduty.com/main/docs/billing-invoices-payments#pagerduty-aiops-consumption-based-pricing" target="_blank">go here</a>.</p>
        </li>
